subject: Final decision cascade: MAP milestones, signature window, and activation slot
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Moss <claire.moss@nimbusretail.com>, Samir Das <samir.d@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final decision cascade: MAP milestones, signature window, and activation slot

Claire / Samir —

Following our last demo, attached is the MAP (v3) and the current SOW draft. We want to lock the execution plan so we can align procurement and legal for signatures. Key asks:

- Confirm the single-signature route (Samir or procurement) vs. multi-signer cadence.
- Lock a 48-hour signature window (we propose 10/28–10/29 PT) so DocuSign routing can be finalised.
- Confirm the preferred start date for activation: we have availability to start provisioning the Dedicated pool on 11/02 or push to 11/09 if you need an extra week.

Proposed decision cascade (recommendation):
1) 10/26 EOD — Final internal approvals (Nimbus legal/procurement).
2) 10/27 — Redwood sends final SOW + DocuSign.
3) 10/28–10/29 — Signature window (48 hours).
4) 11/02 — Target activation (if signed) with onboarding kickoff.

Marissa / Karthik — tagging you for SLA exception review and any procurement steps we should pre-seed.

Attachments: MAP_Nimbus_v3.pdf, SOW_Redwood_Nimbus_20261027.docx

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Account Director, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-9843
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Moss <claire.moss@nimbusretail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Das <samir.d@nimbusretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final decision cascade: MAP milestones, signature window, and activation slot

Thanks Grace —

A couple of quick clarifications from our side before we can commit to the 10/28 window:
- Our procurement lead (cc'd) needs to confirm the billing account and PO timing; if we won't have a PO by 10/28 we prefer to sign but set a 30-day billing grace. Is that acceptable?
- We have a small compliance ask: audit log retention needs to be 13 months. Can Redwood confirm that the dedicated deployment will meet that?

We like the 11/02 activation slot but if we need to push it, 11/09 is workable.

I'll escalate to procurement this morning; expect an update by EOD.

Best,
Claire
Claire Moss
VP, Technology — Nimbus Retail
claire.moss@nimbusretail.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Moss <claire.moss@nimbusretail.com>, Samir Das <samir.d@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final decision cascade: MAP milestones, signature window, and activation slot

Claire —

Thanks for the quick note. Responses inline: 

- Billing / PO: We can accept signature with a 30-day billing grace. We'll document that in the SOW cover sheet as an "invoice hold" clause and route to finance. That should keep procurement moving without delaying DocuSign.

- Audit log retention: Yes — our Dedicated offering supports 13-month retention. I'll loop Aditya (Infra) to add a short statement of evidence (SOC2 control reference + retention config) for your compliance team.

Operational note on signature flow: to minimize delay we recommend the single-signer pattern — Procurement signs once and we capture the Uber-PO on file. If procurement prefers multi-signer, the 48-hour window will need to be extended.

Next steps I will take immediately:
- (today) Update SOW cover sheet with the 30-day invoice hold language and add the audit retention blurb.
- (tomorrow) Send final DocuSign envelope with routing: Procurement -> Nimbus Legal -> Redwood countersign. If Procurement wants single-sign route, we can set DOCUMENT 1 to require only 1 signature and skip legal routing.

Marissa — can you confirm SLA exception approval for 13-month retention and the minor tweak to the SOW?

Grace

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Moss <claire.moss@nimbusretail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final decision cascade: MAP milestones, signature window, and activation slot

Grace — quick thumbs-up from ops: 

- SLA exception for 13-month audit log retention approved (we'll record as an exception in the SOW).
- Aditya / Infra: please prepare the short evidentiary note Claire requested (SOC2 control refs + retention config) and attach to the DocuSign envelope.
- Legal: I'll coordinate a single minor SOW redline (invoice hold clause) — no material change in T&Cs.

If Nimbus confirms single-signer, we can absolutely keep the 10/28–10/29 window. If they need multi-signer, shout and we'll extend to 72 hours.

I'll be available for the signature window and can push the onboarding calendar to secure the 11/02 slot.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Samir Das <samir.d@nimbusretail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Moss <claire.moss@nimbusretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbusretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final decision cascade: MAP milestones, signature window, and activation slot

Grace / team —

Procurement confirms we can take the single-signer route. PO will follow the signature (we'll issue PO within 7 days). Claire confirmed compliance note is sufficient. Please send the DocuSign envelope; we will sign on 10/28 morning PT.

For activation, 11/02 is ideal — please reserve the onboarding slot and the Dedicated pool.

DocuSign link (for reference): https://na1.docusign.net/Signing/?t=abcdef123456

Thanks,
Samir
